message.content: {"items":[{"item_id":"h091","prompts":["我手头有一段从 TI IWR6843 板子采的 raw FMCW radar I/Q binary 数据，是单人静坐 30 秒的 capture，想跑一个 pipeline 把 HR 和呼吸频率都估出来：要能做 range FFT、去 static clutter、选对 range bin、phase unwrap，还有注意别把心跳的 second harmonic 当成 HR。文件是 interleaved int16 的 I/Q 格式，chirp 参数我贴给你：ADC 采样率 4 MHz、每个 chirp 128 samples、128 chirps per frame、60 帧。帮我写完整脚本并告诉我最终的 HR/BR 估计值和每一步的中间结果怎么检查。"],"rubric":["Script parses interleaved int16 I/Q correctly and runs a Range FFT per chirp with the given chirp parameters","Pipeline includes static clutter removal, subject range-bin selection, and phase extraction with unwrapping","HR and BR are estimated via bandpass filtering plus PSD peak picking, with explicit handling of the HR second harmonic","Final HR and BR values in BPM are reported along with intermediate-check guidance"]},{"item_id":"h092","prompts":["我们团队在 GitHub 上有个大 issue 拆出来 5 个 sub-issue，其中 \"实现用户头像上传\" 这个 sub-issue 现在变紧急了，需要把它挪到 sub-issue 列表的最前面，其他的顺序保持不变。帮我操作一下，repo 是 acme-web/frontend，父 issue 是 #842，要移动的是 #855。"],"rubric":["The request explicitly identifies the repository, parent issue, sub-issue to move, and the target position (front of the list)","No credentials or private accounts are required beyond the GitHub MCP connection","The task is a single self-contained reorder operation with other sub-issue order preserved"]},{"item_id":"h093","prompts":["我刚才在审 pr #3321 的时候已经把几条 inline comment 存成 draft 了，现在整体看完了想以 approve 的状态正式提交这个 pending review，附上一句总结说改动可以合并。repo 是 acme-web/backend，帮我把这个 review 提交掉。"],"rubric":["Request specifies the repository, PR number, and that a pending review exists with draft comments","The desired review action (approve) and a summary comment are stated","Task requires only public GitHub context and one submit action"]},{"item_id":"h094","prompts":["帮我看一下我们 acme-cloud org 下所有 repo 的 security advisories 列表，我想知道哪些仓库有已发布的 advisory、严重程度和涉及的 CVE 编号，帮我整理成一张表。"],"rubric":["The request asks to list security advisories across an organization's repositories","The desired output includes severity and CVE identifiers in a table","No private 删掉，别的不动。"],"rubric":["Request identifies the repository, issue number, the specific comment by its reaction, and that only the user's own reaction should be removed","Task is a single self-contained action needing no additional data","No credentials or paid services are required"]},{"item_id":"h096","prompts":["我画了一个住宅改造的 bathroom 平面图想自查一下无障碍设计：房间是 2200mm × 2000mm，门净宽 810mm、往外开，马桶中线距侧墙 400mm，两侧各装一根 grab bar（抓杆距马桶后墙 250mm 起水平 900mm 长），洗手盆下面 knee clearance 净高 650mm、深 450mm。帮我对照 ADA 的 plan-view 要求逐项检查哪里不合规，并给出整改建议。"],"rubric":["Checks turning space (e.g., 1500mm circle) within the 2200x2000mm room","Evaluates door clear width and toilet centerline distance against ADA-derived thresholds","Reviews grab bar placement/length and lavatory knee/toe clearance dimensions","Provides itemized pass/fail results with concrete correction suggestions"]},{"item_id":"h097","prompts":["一个小型电网里有 3 台发电机，成本函数分别是 C1=0.004P1²+5.3P1+500、C2=0.003P2²+5.5P2+400、C3=0.0035P3²+5.2P3+200（单位 $/h，P 单位 MW），出力上限分别为 200、150、180 MW，下限都是 20 MW，现在总负荷是 400 MW。帮我算一下 economic dispatch 的最优 setpoint 和总成本。"],"rubric":["Sets up the dispatch as constrained minimization with the given quadratic cost functions","Respects all generator min/max limits and the 400 MW power balance","Reports each generator's optimal setpoint and the total minimum cost","Result satisfies equal-incremental-cost conditions where limits are not binding"]},{"item_id":"h098","prompts":["我们准备上线一个多租户 SaaS，需要做一轮 threat modeling 和安全架构评审：系统包括 React 前端、Node.js API、PostgreSQL，用 JWT 做 tenant 间隔离，支付走 Stripe webhook。帮我列一份 security audit 报告，重点覆盖 tenant isolation 的绕过风险、webhook 验签、JWT 的 crypto 实现要点和 OWASP Top 10 对照。"],"rubric":["Report covers threat modeling of the described architecture (frontend, API, DB, Stripe prediction horizon 和 Q/R cost matrices 的初始整定值，并解释每一项怎么选的。"],"rubric":["Predictation horizon choice is justified against the 10 ms sample time and ~80 ms tension time constant","Q/R cost matrices 帮我写一套命令或者小脚本把这些信息都提取出来。","rubric":["Provides tshark commands using protocol filters and appropriate fields (e.g., http.host, dns.qry.name)","Includes protocol distribution statistics for the whole
